_comments: THE DAILY SERIES EXTENSION. MJ's SchedulingEngine is the mechanism; no external cron.

CronExpression `0 0 3 * * *`: six fields, seconds first, so 03:00 UTC every day. ConcurrencyMode Skip: a run that overlaps the last one is skipped. MissedRunPolicy RunOnce: catching up needs one run, not one per missed day.
OwnerUserID and NotifyUserID are left NULL: naming a person here would seed one deployment's staff into another's database.
Configuration is a native JSON object (MJ/metadata/CLAUDE.md § 1c). No sync block.

fields.Name: Tasks — Meeting Series (daily)
fields.Description: Extends every active meeting series' occurrences up to 90 days ahead, through the Meeting Series Materialization job type.
